title: Bonnie C
content: Outside it was raining hard. We were at a restaurant. While eating inside, I choked and stopped breathing. My husband, who is a doctor, began performing the Heimlich maneuver on me. I was wearing a red jacket that reached my hips, blue jeans, and red sneakers. My body felt very light and I was suspended in the air. My feet were weightless. My right leg was slightly higher than the left leg. My arms extended just below my shoulders. My face was turned toward another face that looked like mine but decades younger. The face had deep, penetrating, and illuminated eyes. I noticed here looking at me with a peaceful and attentive gaze, silently urging me to look at her or stay with her. Her radiant eyes met mine directly. The younger face was serene, softly smiling while exuding peace, joy, and calmness. In this state, I simply waited, filled with profound peace and no anxiety. I felt frozen, unable to move. I could hear my husband calling for an ambulance and asking if I could speak, but I couldn’t. Finally, I began to breathe slowly and could barely speak. When I returned, I was overwhelmed by an immense sense of peace, calmness, and joy.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes, choking, Life threatening event, but not clinical death
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: I clearly left my body and existed outside it
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: More consciousness and alertness than normal, I was feeling embraced by a lot of love and peace
elements.At what time during the experience were: a few seconds after I stopped breathing
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning, I was listening to my husband asking for help and if I could speak; while I was in this peaceful state looking at the face described before.
elements.Did you seem to be aware of things going: Yes, but the facts have not been checked out
elements.Did you pass into or through a tunnel?: Uncertain, I may have been approaching a bright tunnel.
elements.Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a br: A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Yes, The face in the distance in front of me was illuminated. It was like a bright, broad-spectrum white light emanated from her eyes and face.
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm, I was close to a very mystical figure.
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt united or one with the world
elements.Did your experience include features con: Content that was both consistent and not consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience, I am a Catholic person and I am used to praying on an ongoing basis, which gives a sense of peace to my life. But the peace I felt in the experience was beyond this, like a feeling that cannot be destroyed or spoiled by anyone or anything.
elements.Did you seem to encounter a mystical bei: I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin, I encountered a peacefully illuminated face that seemed to communicate for me to stay with her.
elements.During your experience, did you gain inf: Yes, A peaceful feeling surrounded by love with a sense of coming from something greater than myself.
Yes, The peace I felt looking at this face was beyond any earthly feeling.
Yes, A peaceful feeling surrounded by love.
elements.What life changes occurred in your life: I feel love and compassion for everyone around me. For those who made me feel uneasy or upset before the experience, I feel them closer to my heart now, and the negative feelings have gone away.
elements.Have your relationships changed specific: Yes, I find myself with much more tolerance and a closer, more loving attitude toward a few people who made me feel uneasy before the experience.
elements.How accurately do you remember the exper: I remember the experience as accurately as other life events that occurred around the time of the experience, I have a very good visual memory. I usually remember most of the details of my experiences.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: The peaceful feeling I had that was beyond the regular feeling of constant prayers.
elements.Did you have any knowledge of near death: Yes, Literature, a few books I read a while ago about people who have experienced NDEs.
elements.What did you believe about the reality o: Experience was definitely real, The peaceful feeling, above anything I have felt before, stayed within me.
